# Purpose

This Quarto document is used to load krill size data and check if it follows tidy principles

# Setup

loading packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```

# Read in the data

loading my data file as krill_size

```{r}
krill_size <- read_excel(here::here("data", "raw", "KrillData.xlsx"))


```

# View data

viewing data to check if it is tidy

```{r}
View(krill_size)
```

# Conclusion

Data follows all 3 principles of tidy data.
